title: Shop
blurb: Replay of a recorded run: a builder agent's recorded run of a small web shop, from skeleton to admin page, over six milestones. Every recorded write is applied, and a recorded command runs again in a Workspace unless it repeats an earlier run on a Branch that has not changed since.

bash.command:
# 006 M1: initialize project and skeleton
set -eo pipefail
layerfs() { node "$DSH_LAYERFS_CLI" "$@"; }
. "{{scenario}}/../shared/replay.sh"
sb=$(layerfs sandbox create --image sha256:091f785ba7d5d036dfa350e8fd69ee1fcd2d8320c3706841c8c95e6411eee9d2 | field sandbox)
keep sandbox-root "$sb"; keep image sha256:091f785ba7d5d036dfa350e8fd69ee1fcd2d8320c3706841c8c95e6411eee9d2; echo "Sandbox $sb"
layerfs branch fork skeleton | kind Forked
layerfs fs apply skeleton -m '006 M1: scaffold server, scripts, health test and merge rules' --from "{{scenario}}/changes/001.json" | kind Committed   # 15 change(s)

# 007 M1: install dependencies
set -eo pipefail
layerfs() { node "$DSH_LAYERFS_CLI" "$@"; }
. "{{scenario}}/../shared/replay.sh"
sb=$(sandbox_of root)
ws=$(layerfs workspace mount "$sb" skeleton | field ws); echo "mounted skeleton as $ws"
code=0; layerfs workspace exec "$ws" -m '007 M1: install dependencies' --stream -- 'timeout 100 npm install --no-audit --no-fund' || code=$?
exit_is "$code" 0
layerfs workspace commit "$ws" -m '007 M1: npm install (exit 0)' | kind Committed
layerfs workspace unmount "$ws" | kind Unmounted

# 008 M1: test and publish skeleton
set -eo pipefail
layerfs() { node "$DSH_LAYERFS_CLI" "$@"; }
. "{{scenario}}/../shared/replay.sh"
sb=$(sandbox_of root)
ws=$(layerfs workspace mount "$sb" skeleton | field ws); echo "mounted skeleton as $ws"
code=0; layerfs workspace exec "$ws" -m '008 M1: health tests' --stream -- 'timeout 30 npm test' || code=$?
exit_is "$code" 0
layerfs workspace commit "$ws" -m '008 M1: health tests (exit 0)' | kind Committed UpToDate
layerfs workspace unmount "$ws" | kind Unmounted
head=$(layerfs branch list_commits skeleton --page-size 1 | field items.0.id)
layerfs branch publish skeleton "$head" | kind Added
layerfs branch fork catalog | kind Forked

# 009 M2: implement catalog
set -eo pipefail
layerfs() { node "$DSH_LAYERFS_CLI" "$@"; }
. "{{scenario}}/../shared/replay.sh"
layerfs fs apply catalog -m '009 M2: JSON store, catalog queries and structured validation' --from "{{scenario}}/changes/004.json" | kind Committed   # 4 change(s)

import assert from '''node:assert/strict''';
import {fixture} from '''./helpers.js''';
test('''catalog: seed, sorting, filters, search and paging''',async t=>{
  const {request}=await fixture(t);
  const all=(await request('''/api/products?pageSize=50''')).body;
  assert.equal(all.total,30); assert.ok(new Set(all.items.map(p=>p.category)).size>=4);
  assert.ok(all.items.some(p=>p.stock===0)); assert.ok(all.items.some(p=>p.stock===1));
  assert.deepEqual(all.items.map(p=>p.name),all.items.map(p=>p.name).sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b)));
  const category=(await request('''/api/products?category=Kitchen''')).body;
  assert.equal(category.total,6); assert.ok(category.items.every(p=>p.category==='''Kitchen'''));
  const search=(await request('''/api/products?q=AMBER''')).body;
  assert.equal(search.total,1); assert.equal(search.items[0].id,'''mug-classic''');
  assert.equal((await request('''/api/products?q=rituals''')).body.total,30);
  assert.equal((await request('''/api/products?page=2&pageSize=7''')).body.items.length,7);
  assert.equal((await request('''/api/products?page=999''')).body.items.length,0);
  for(const query of ['''page=0''','''page=-1''','''page=x''','''pageSize=0''','''pageSize=51''','''pageSize=2.2''']) assert.equal((await request('''/api/products?'''+query)).status,400);
  assert.equal((await request('''/api/products/missing''')).status,404);
  assert.equal((await request('''/api/products/mug-classic''')).body.priceCents,1250);
  const categories=(await request('''/api/categories''')).body.items;
  assert.equal(categories.length,5); assert.deepEqual(categories.map(c=>c.name),categories.map(c=>c.name).sort());
});
");
